title: Privacy deletion / tombstone propagation
invariants: deletion generation is monotonic per tenant and target
tombstone declares every required propagation surface
acknowledgement binds exact tenant, target, generation, surface, tombstone and evidence
stale or future acknowledgement fails closed
source generations at or before tombstone are denied as resurrection attempts
newer generations require explicit creation authority
completion requires acknowledgement from every declared surface
authority persists metadata only and never deleted payloads
claim_limit: Implementation evidence only; independent exact-head evidence is required before verified_closed.
